mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which leads to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where the FEDFUNDS rate increases by more than 0.25% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in real estate sales (HOUST) signals a strengthening economy and increased consumer confidence, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where HOUST increases for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals economic distress, leading to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE increases by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a weakening supply chain and reduced economic output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real disposable personal income (RSAFS) coupled with a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals increased consumer spending power and confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases and UNRATE decreases simultaneously
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where RSAFS increases and UNRATE decreases simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) signals inflationary pressures, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL increases for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases simultaneously
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in real GDP (GDPC1) signals a robust economic expansion, leading to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where GDPC1 increases for 3 consecutive months.
